posts.post_subject: My first H2 using Dave Battin
posts.content_md:
Hey Dave,

Thanks a lot for you’re tutorial on coating. My greenie days are behind me now (fingers crossed).

This is a reflection copy on DCG from a reflection DCG master. The owl comes off the plate about 1 cm. 

315M @ 6minutes

Photographed under standard light bulb.

![Image](http://home.wi.rr.com/cavin/OwlH2_1_1.jpg)

![Image](http://home.wi.rr.com/cavin/OwlH2dcg.jpg)
